Package model

Class Course

java.lang.Object
model.Course
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Course extends Object implements Serializable
Represents university course in the system. Course contains information about:name, credits, year of study, major,instructors and enrolled students. One course can have several teachers and many enrolled students.
